profile.entities: Permanent Magnets Ltd (PML, standalone); Quantum Magnetics (rare-earth subsidiary, $5m ECB raised); new consolidated Vasai (Ahmedabad highway) factory site
profile.mgmt: Sharad Taparia (MD); Sukhmal Jain (SVP & CFO); Sayam Pokharna (IR, TIL Advisors)
profile.subseg: Permanent magnets & magnetic assemblies; Soft-magnetic Alloys division (virgin & scrap-route); Electrical Relays / contacts; Quantum Magnetics (rare-earth magnet JV/subsidiary)
profile.themes: EV (magnetic components into EU/US EV platforms); Renewable-Integration (energy/electricity meters); Grid-Capex (smart/electricity meter relays) — genuine but currently soft

deepdive.sec: Specialty Magnetics & Soft-Magnetic Alloys (rare-earth assemblies, electrical contacts/relays, precision alloys)

bull_bear.body:
- Increased borrowing limits; consolidated debt rose mainly via $5m ECB for subsidiary capex (standalone debt modest ~INR 20 cr).
- Heavy reinvestment phase across all three pillars + new factory; no dividend/buyback commentary.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body:
- **Chronic execution slippage** — Relays delayed multiple times (now H2 FY27); investor flagged "very poor show" on commercialization vs prior guidance.
- China rare-earth export curbs → zero magnet revenue FY26; no approvals received.
- EV exposure concentrated in EU/US platforms losing share to Chinese OEMs; no Chinese-EV business.
- Competition in rare-earth (5-6 players + big names planning, PLI-driven) and Alloys.
- Funding mix for large FY27 capex unsettled; consolidated debt rising.
- Poor IR responsiveness flagged by an investor (unanswered meeting requests).
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: - Candid and measured; explicitly acknowledged delays ("it has been delayed to that extent, yes"). Conservative on guidance, repeatedly hedging on customer-order timing. Tone realistic but credibility dented by repeated commercialization delays and an IR-access complaint.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body:
- FY26 "growth" (+13%) is almost entirely an H2/Alloys phenomenon masking a weak H1; rare-earth — the headline optionality — contributed nothing.
- The big consolidated debt jump (INR 15→85 cr feared by an investor) is largely a definitional/ECB artifact, not standalone balance-sheet stress — CFO actively corrected the INR 85 cr figure.
- Relays revenue is a high-uncertainty bet: INR 25-50 cr range at "100% utilization" of a capacity still being phased in, fully dependent on customer adoption speed.
- Light-vs-heavy rare-earth substitution trend is a quiet structural positive PML is positioning for.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body:
- **Alloys**: new furnace installed Jan 2026, commercialized Q4, ran near full util.; product split virgin metal (lower margin, dominant in Q4) vs scrap-route (higher margin); mix to be clearer by Q1-Q2 FY27.
- **Relays**: import-substitution play (largely imported today; PML had one smart-meter customer, now broad-basing). Avg meter value INR 250-300; TAM ~INR 6,500-7,000 cr on 25 cr meter replacement cycle.
- **Quantum Magnetics** (subsidiary): rare-earth magnets; raised $5m ECB; PML contribution ~$5m over ~18 months; Phase 1 (assemblies) done, Phase 2 under implementation.
business.title: Segment / subsidiary

business.body:
| Challenge | Beneficiary stock(s) | Loser | Why / conviction |
|---|---|---|---|
| China rare-earth magnet export curbs forcing domestic localization + PLI | PML / Quantum Magnetics 504132·504132 | Importers of finished rare-earth magnets/assemblies | PML building 5,000t plant; but FY26 revenue = nil, execution unproven — Low-Med conviction |
| Smart/electricity meter relay import-substitution (TAM ~INR 6.5-7k cr) | PML 504132·504132 ; Genus Power (code unverified) | Chinese/foreign relay importers | PML broad-basing beyond single customer; Relays delayed to H2 FY27 — Med conviction |
| Alloys ramp into oil & gas / aerospace | PML 504132·504132 | Higher-cost / pure-import alloy suppliers | New furnace at ~80-90% util., 3-4x FY27 volume guided — Med-High conviction |
| EV magnetic components shifting to Chinese OEMs / China EV dominance | Chinese EV-magnet supply chain | PML 504132·504132 (EU/US-platform exposure) | PML's EV sales skew to losing EU/US platforms; no China-EV business — Med conviction (a headwind for PML) |
business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

latest_quarter.body:
- FY26 EBITDA 17% (vs 14% FY25) on mix + H2 scale. Q4 15%, down QoQ.
- Virgin-metal alloy sales dilute margin vs scrap-route; near-term mix skewed to virgin metal.
- Guidance keeps margins flat (~15-18%) despite ramp — limited near-term operating leverage signaled.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

latest_quarter.body:
- Q4 standalone revenue INR 66 cr (+47% YoY) vs softer H1; FY26 INR 225 cr (+13%).
- Q4 EBITDA margin 15% — up YoY, down QoQ (vs FY26 17%).
- Alloys furnace newly commercialized in Q4 (Jan install) — first quarter of meaningful Alloys contribution.
- Relays timeline pushed again: now H2 FY27 commercial ramp (vs earlier-expected sooner).
- Rare-earth/Quantum: Phase 1 done, Phase 2 now under implementation; first sales pushed to ~Q4 FY27.
- $5m ECB newly raised in subsidiary — consolidated debt up vs prior.
- vs prior call: China-restriction easing expected "by Q3/Jan-Feb" did NOT materialize — no approvals, no magnet sales.
latest_quarter.title: QoQ change log

outlook.body:
- FY27 consolidated revenue growth **20-30%** (could exceed on large orders), driven primarily by Alloys; Relays/Quantum additive.
- FY27 EBITDA margin held **~15-18%** (similar to FY26).
- Alloys: FY27 volume **3-4x** of FY26 contribution.
- Relays: commercial ramp from **H2 FY27**; peak FY27 revenue INR 25-50 cr at ~100% util (phased 5m → 10m unit capacity).
- Quantum/rare-earth: Phase 2 (block cutting/machining/surface treatment) in Q3-Q4 FY27; first assembly sales ~Dec FY27, ~INR 10-15 cr in Q4 FY27.
- No FY28/29/30 numeric guidance given (deferred).
outlook.title: Guidance (next quarter / year)

outlook.body:
- No consolidated order-book figure disclosed.
- Alloys: engaging customers in oil & gas (already in commercial production), aerospace, others; oil & gas the near-term ramp driver.
- Relays: customer approvals/testing in progress; production equipment purchase contingent on which orders "click first."
- Rare-earth: long-term 5,000-tonne plant plan; full build-out only by ~FY30-31, revenue potential INR 3,000-4,000 cr at full scale (highly conditional).
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body:
- Rare-earth magnet localization (PLI scheme being evaluated, not yet applied) — large optionality but early and contested.
- Customers shifting heavy-rare-earth → light-rare-earth designs (potential future tailwind for PML).
- Chinese EV makers with Indian collaborations: PML developing products for them; cannot yet sell into China directly.
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: A small-cap specialty-magnetics maker pivoting from a cyclical legacy base (meters, auto, exports) toward three optionality-rich growth pillars — Alloys (now ramping), Relays (import-substitution, delayed to H2 FY27) and rare-earth magnets via Quantum Magnetics — where execution has chronically lagged guidance and the China rare-earth choke has zeroed FY26 magnet revenue.
